blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebuana triathlon ace Raven Faith Alcoseba continued her impressive international campaign after capturing the bronze medal in the Elite Women’s category of the 2026 Asia Triathlon Sprint Championships in Aqaba, Jordan.
